author: Brett Minkin
text: Every CGM is at risk for compression lows. That’s why we have to assess if it’s a real low glucose or a compression low. That’s why I wait a few minutes before taking action when I get one. Several times, my CGM caught a real low glucose, and alarmed and woke me up. A finger stick glucose is just a snapshot of a moment in time. What’s more important, is the trending, for which a CGM is invaluable.

text: If it’s so bad don’t use it!
